title: Uruguayan Stew Recipe
description: A hearty and flavorful Uruguayan stew recipe made with tender beef and flavorful vegetables.
instructions: Heat oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Add beef and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add onion, garlic, and red bell pepper. Cook until the vegetables are tender, about 5 minutes.
Add carrots and potatoes. Cook for an additional 5 minutes.
Stir in tomato paste, beef broth, and red wine (if using).
Bring the stew to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 1 1/2 hours, or until the beef is tender.
Stir in diced pear during the last 30 minutes of cooking.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh parsley, if desired.
